seo.title: Sunset Esports — Own the glow
seo.description: Sunset Esports — an independent esports organization. Play with purpose. Own the glow. Est. 2026.

hero.lineOne: The sun always sets. The ones who shine never do.
hero.lineTwo: We’re here to play bold, grow together, and make our moment count.

story.lead: Good teams are bigger than the game.
story.description: Sunset Esports is a Gaming organization focused on competitive excellence, content creation, community, and long-term growth. Join the server to connect with our community, stay updated, and be part of the journey.

principles.description: Strong teams start with good people. Respect, trust, and community come before anything.
Every match is a chance to learn. We put the work in and bring our teammates along.
We want the next generation to see what’s possible and have a place to start.

journey.descriptionTop: A fresh start. A shared direction.

milestones.headline: A new light.
milestones.description: Sunset starts with a shared love of competition and a team ready to make its own mark.

milestones.headline: Built together.
milestones.description: Players, creators, and supporters come together. Every good run is a team effort.

milestones.headline: Made to rise.
milestones.description: New faces. New stages. We’re just getting warmed up — the best is still ahead.

join.overline: FOR THE FEARLESS. THE FOCUSED. THE NEXT.
join.description: There’s room for people who want more from competition. If you’re hungry to improve, ready to contribute, and good to your teammates — we want to hear from you.
join.note: Players, creators, and partners — come say hello.

merch.status: THE FIRST COLLECTION IS IN THE WORKS
merch.description: We’re getting the first Sunset drop ready. Nothing is available just yet—check back soon for updates.
